purpose: Ocho ilustraciones para el debate previo a la sección sobre el Vaticano.

prompts.name: 01-roma
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a standalone landscape 3:2 editorial illustration for a critical discussion of Vatican history and symbolism. Refined painterly realism, consistent warm stone and bronze, deep blue shadows, restrained gold light. No lettering, captions, watermarks or invented documentary markings. Treat as an openly artistic illustration, not photographic evidence. Vatican and Rome geographically: recognizable St Peter's Basilica dome and square in foreground, continuous city of Rome beyond with distant ancient Roman ruins and Colosseum. Warm late afternoon, architectural panorama. No battle, no demons or allegations.

prompts.name: 02-aula-serpiente
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a standalone landscape 3:2 editorial illustration for a critical discussion of Vatican history and symbolism. Refined painterly realism, consistent warm stone and bronze, deep blue shadows, restrained gold light. No lettering, captions, watermarks or invented documentary markings. Treat as an openly artistic illustration, not photographic evidence. Visual comparison diptych with no text: left, symmetrical interior of the Paul VI audience hall, distinctive concrete ribbed vaulted ceiling sweeping toward the front stage, lateral oval window forms; right, naturalistic close-up of a snake's head with its two eyes, viewed frontally. Clearly separate the architecture from the animal; do not morph the building into a literal snake. Neutral architectural and natural history comparison.

Clear upright perspective and warm light. Evoke its ancient Egyptian origin through material and form, do not invent hieroglyphs.
